mapper.sql: SELECT track.id, track.title, track.image_url AS imageUrl, album.id AS albumId, album.title AS albumTitle, album.image_url AS albumImageUrl, artist.id AS artistId, artist.name AS artistName, artist.image_url AS artistImageUrl FROM track JOIN album on track.album_id = album.id JOIN artist on track.artist_id = artist.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO track (title, image_url, album_id, artist_id) VALUES (#{entity.title}, #{entity.imageUrl}, #{entity.albumId}, #{entity.artistId});
